fieldDescription: Generates custom star systems [during new game creation]. Disabling this will disable [all] custom star systems from generating in new games! Edit [customStarSystems.json], located in the CustomizableStarSystems mod folder, if you wish to disable individual custom star systems instead.
Additional distance a custom star system generates away from other star systems when using "setLocation". Only applies to [systems not using the (x,y) "setLocation" option].
